name: Moon Wolf's Real Alpha
overview: Eileen is the daughter of the Alpha of Crimson Valley Pack. Her mate will most likely be another Alpha werewolf, but after witnessing her mate making out with another woman and being hurt by them as a result, she escapes and decides to become a single mother and not succumb to her destiny. Eileen didn't expect to meet her true mate Alpha Watt again, the most powerful Alpha, who also had a failed marriage...
